what: Hovering a header trigger (Product·Solutions·Developers) turns on the white dropdown panel beneath it in .15s, and moving to another trigger slides the single panel, with its content swapped, to beneath the new trigger in .3s ease (trigger left − 124px). It turns off .15s after leaving the trigger·panel, and also closes with Esc. The trigger keeps a gray background as the on indicator.

options.shift: Px to pull the panel’s left edge past the trigger’s left edge, default 124
options.delay: Delay after the hand leaves before closing (sec), default .15
options.fade: Time (s) for the panel to switch on and off, default .15
options.fade-ease: Plate turn-on curve (css value), default ease — increase uses cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)
options.slide-ease: Panel slide curve (css value), default ease
options.[data-fx-part=trigger]: Trigger — pick a menu with data-key
options.[data-fx-part=pop]: Panel slot (the user places it absolute below the header row)
options.[data-fx-part=menu]: One menu item inside the panel — shown at the trigger with the same data-key

note: On touch screens (hover false) the trigger opens and closes on tap. The panel size changes straight to fit its content and only the position moves. The original (increase) wrote transition: transform 300ms ease all inline, but the value is wrong (all comes last) so the browser discards it and the panel actually jumps straight over — measured and confirmed with motion-probe. So increase is written as slide: 0, and the default .3 is the value for when you want it to slide as written.

from.where: Header line on all pages .i-nav__in — slide: 0; fade-ease: cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) (original [data-nav-popover]: opacity 150ms Tailwind default curve, inner translateX(trigger left − 124px) instantly, closes 150ms after mouseleave)
